title: Lit windows: a solid building + painted window decals, not an emissive room box
summary: An emissive room box in a tower cab read as a flat orange block. Keep the building solid; add emissive window decals painted with the warm room, frames and a dark occupant.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: guardTower() in module.recon.prison-props (winTex(guard): gradient + frame + guard shape, emissiveMap at .75)

doc.when: Night buildings, towers, houses with lit windows seen from outside.
gotchas: Lift decals off the wall (2 cm) and mark them noContact.

problem.symptom: Lit windows read as a flat orange block.
problem.cause: One emissive volume fills the whole opening: no depth, frame or occupant.
problem.fix: Solid walls + per-face window decals painted with interior light, frames and a silhouette.
problem.detect: The window has no internal variation.
